thread:
Priya: FYI Acme (acct ACME-1129) disputes invoice INV-2026-1129 — unexpected usage spike on 2026-02-27. They're asking for a $1,250 credit. Screenshot attached. Can finance review? /cc @jonah
Jonah: Customer says a test harness accidentally used prod keys and ran embeddings for ~2 hours. They claim it's a one-off and request goodwill since first incident.
Maya: I pulled the invoice and usage. Looks like 25M tokens at our slab rates. We can do a manual adjustment but need approvals for amounts > $1k.
Alex: Can you paste the invoice line items and link to the TOS/contract clause if they're citing that? Also we need GL code and sign-off from finance lead + CFO for > $1k.
Maya: Invoice snippet:
```
INV-2026-1129:
  Usage charges: $1,750
  Promo credits applied: $500
  Balance due: $1,250
```
Customer is asking for the full $1,250 refunded as account credit.
Riley: GL for customer credits is 7130 (Customer Credits & Subsidies). For manual journals use reference format JV-BILL-YYYYMMDD. We'll need a reason code 'goodwill_customer_error' and the email thread as evidence for audit.
Priya: @Alex @Sam tagging for approval. Acme is strategic and NPS is high — recommend making them whole once.
Alex: I provisionally approve a goodwill credit of $1,250 pending CFO sign-off. Please note this against Q1 adjustments bucket when you record the journal.
Sam: I've reviewed the usage logs and the support convo. Approve one-time goodwill credit of $1,250. Please ensure deferred revenue is adjusted accordingly. :thumbsup:
Maya: Executing manual credit in billing console now. Command I'm running:
```
billing-cli credit --acct ACME-1129 --invoice INV-2026-1129 --amount 1250 --reason 'goodwill_customer_error' --ref JV-BILL-20260301
```
I'll update when it completes.
billing-bot: billing-bot: Manual credit job queued (BILL-9321). Estimated completion ~5 minutes.
Maya: Done — Credit issued and applied as account balance. Invoice INV-2026-1129 now shows $0 balance. Ticket #BILL-9321. Journal ref JV-BILL-20260301 sent to accounting.
Riley: Journal posted: Entry ID 56-2026-03. GL 7130 credited $1,250; Deferred Revenue debited. Attached JV PDF in the ticket. Closing the accounting side.
Priya: Thanks all — I'll confirm with Acme they see the credit and close the case on our side. :sparkles:
